ipaddresshider.button.locked_by_streamer: To show this IP you have to disable Streamer Mode
ipaddresshider.settings.title: IP Address Hider
ipaddresshider.option.streamer_mode.desc: Hides every server name and address, whatever each server is set to. Individual locks are remembered and come back when you turn this off.
ipaddresshider.option.twitch.desc: Lets "Only while live" know when your channel is live. Asks Twitch about once a minute - nothing else, no chat or channel permissions.
ipaddresshider.twitch.enter_code: Go to twitch.tv/activate and enter this code:
ipaddresshider.option.only_live.desc: Streamer Mode only takes effect while your Twitch channel is live. Off: it works whenever Streamer Mode is on - use that for recordings, YouTube or Discord screen sharing, which Twitch cannot see.
ipaddresshider.option.only_live.needs_tw: Connect your Twitch account first - without it this cannot tell when you are live.
